A renowned establishment on the moon of Carnate. The circus is a place of joy. Or perhaps a corportate ploy to exhaust the common people of their finance while overworking and tormenting those who worked under the circus umbrella with hands of careless greed. Who knows. High value plushies remain inside.

> Moon Map

> Moon Info

POPULATION: Abandoned

CONDITIONS: Warm. healthy environment, mostly covered by forest.

FAUNA: Rich and healthy ecosystem.

> Environment

Carnate has hilly and forested terrain with two lakes to the south and northwest. Fireflies appear around the exteiror as time progresses. Several circus tents, balloons, picnic tables, poles with lights, speakers, and party streamers, and carousels like the ones found in the Toy Store can be found on the exterior as well. If the breaker box is turned off in the interior, the lights on the exterior will also turn off.

Players can go inside the large red and yellow tents, which typically have several tables and chairs as well as a star with an eye in the center of the floor. Four of these tents are the main entrance and fire exits. The main entrance is in the tent southwest of the ship, a fire exit tent is south and slightly west of the ship and behind the main entrance tent, another fire exit tent is far northeast of the ship, and the last fire exit tent is north of the ship.

> Weather

Carnate supports Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Flooded, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, Forsaken, Hallowed, Hurricane, and Minefield weather by default.

> Moon Exclusive Content

Longer Day

Carnate has a default day speed multiplier of 0.85, meaning players can stay on the moon longer.

Unique Music

Carnate additionally has two unique ambient tracks that play from the speakers on the exterior.

Carnate Ambience 1

Carnate Ambience 2

Major Story Spoilers: Falling Debris

If players decided to overload and blow up ResearcherxB, debris from the ship can fall onto Carnate's exterior west of the ship near a tent. If players land on Carnate in the future on that save file, a mild infestation of white mold will be present and four Infected Bunker Spiders will spawn at the start of the day on the exterior.

Image ⁠

> Progression

Unlocked By

Opening the keycard door and interacting with the Databox next to the left ship lever on ResearcherxB. This must be done before ResearcherxB begins its crash sequence or players overload and blow it up on that save file.

Unlocks

End: Acquire the destiny item Mycete case that spawns as random scrap within the interior and insert it into the destiny item slot before taking off in the abandoned ship on Repress.

> Lore

Escape Pod 1

A Databox can be found north and slightly east of the ship nearby a crashed escape pod and off the path leading to the north fire exit. The data in it is a transcript of the last recorded conversation between Cavil Darter and Solover Underhill.

Text ⁠
Transcript emergency recording
—----------------------- 2:50

S. Underhill: I know you’re there Cavil.
S. Underhill: You realise we possess the ability to read the security transcripts from our headquarters.
S. Underhill: Your pod sent out a distress signal, Cavil. I know where you are.
C. Darter: Fuck you.
S. Underhill: Do you believe you are doing the right thing?
C. Darter: Stopping you from murdering innocents? Yes. Yes I believe I am.
S. Underhill: By murdering innocents of your own?
C. Darter: I didn’t mean to.
S. Underhill: Yet you did. In an attempt to sabotage my plans you killed not just one, but two. You gave Sarah the illusion of escape. But Julian would’ve been left to die all alone. You are a hypocrite.
C. Darter: I have your documents. I know what you did. Your experiments at the Crosswind Mental Hospital in Last Hope. Hailey Robertson, remember her? It’s all there. It will all be public soon enough.
S. Underhill: And you think that changes things? We can tell the public anything and they’ll believe it.
C. Darter: If this gets out you become a risk. Risks don’t tend to live long.
S. Underhill: Then what. I’ve finished my machine. You think they’ll stop? It’s working. It’s working really well. You may have sabotaged your mission but we’ll find that ship, one way or another. Then project Mycete will be perfect. The soldiers we produce will be impenetrable, unstoppable. We will rescue so many cities from their lawlessness. We will unite what’s left after the silent age. You can stop the engineer, but not his machine.
C. Darter: You’re lost, Sol. You’re lost in your own fantasy.
S. Underhill: Don’t you see it? The cities we’ve saved? The people exist in peace. We brought them that peace. We’ve perfected it. You give people too much will, they destroy themselves. You give them too little, they destroy their government. You give them just enough, they’re happy. It doesn’t even have to be real. History is an archive of mistakes, an encyclopedia of lessons, we are the only ones who chose not to ignore them.
C. Darter: You can’t call it peace when you’re the one bringing war. Maybe I can’t stop the project. But I can stop you.
—----------------------- 
Emergency recording ended

The Entity

This recording can randomly spawn as scrap within the interior.

Text ⁠
It strikes a fear in me, rooted deep within my ocean of thought. He kept asking about it and I don't even have the full answer. They have a way of operating that makes them invisible to not only the surface but even those who'd consider themselves high up the ladder. But I know they're here. They're everywhere. Stare long enough into the abyss, you start seeing things. Holes in reality. Fissures in logic. Yet you shake your head and pretend it was your eyes playing tricks on you. I see them. Companies appear more and more frequent like an infestation of roaches from influential businessmen to lower class entrepreneurs. All with history, documents, lives. Processed within our systems. It's usual. Standard practice. Nothing strange about it. But you look closer. You read their documents. Everything seems normal until.. you get a glimpse. A date mismatched. A name changed. Manlike mistakes, for sure. Look deeper, closer. Children without proof of birth. Deposits from companies that only registered days later. Trades between people who don't even know each other. Fissures. I've never observed them, my superiors have never seen them. Only stories.. irregularities. Seemingly random. But I think they are connected. They're here. And I believe they're scared. There is something here that scares them, threatens them. Makes them slip up. And if something is here that scares the corporate entity that’s able to twist our reality no matter where in our galaxy. You best know I sleep with one eye open.

> Trivia

  • Carnate takes the longest to unlock of any moon in Wesley's Moons, requiring a minimum of routing to 15 different moons.
  • Carnate is the only moon that has a high chance of spawning the Carnival interior by default.
